description: This Java source file defines the `UpdateFilterModel` class, which encapsulates properties and behaviors related to database update management within the OpenMRS web application, particularly for use by the `StartupFilter`. It manages database change sets, version checks, and the required updates process.

classes.name: UpdateFilterModel
classes.description: A model object for managing update-related properties in the OpenMRS startup process, including changesets, version info, and update status.

methods.name: UpdateFilterModel
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the model with default provider implementations.

methods.name: UpdateFilterModel(LiquibaseProvider, DatabaseUpdaterWrapper)
methods.description: Constructor allowing injection of specific LiquibaseProvider and DatabaseUpdaterWrapper instances, initializing the list of changes and update requirement status.

methods.name: updateChanges
methods.description: Updates the list of unrun database change sets by querying the database updater wrapper.
